request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Backing is now the sum of the patrons' settled figures over their SETTLED claims dated within the
90 days up to and including the sheet's today (each at its frozen figure), 0.00 with none.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Backing now adds up the patrons' settled claims dated in the 90 days up to and including the sheet's today, each at its frozen figure. A person with no patrons, or whose patrons have no such claims, shows 0.00. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The change is front end only, since backing was already worked out there and nothing on the server or in the stored data needed to change:

- **`src/main/frontend/features/rates/ratesQuery.ts`**: a new `recentSettled` helper adds up a person's settled claims dated from today minus 89 days through today (90 days counting both ends). For example, with today 2026-03-10 the window starts on 2025-12-11.
- **`src/main/frontend/features/rates/due.slot.tsx`**: the backing cell (`person-backing`) now adds up `recentSettled` for each patron. Before, it added up their due-totals.

Two cases the request didn't spell out:
- A claim settled while no rate applied has no frozen figure, so it adds nothing.
- Settled corrections (negative amounts) count at their frozen figure, so they lower the backing.
